name: coding-agent memory scenarios
status: authored before any run; provisional agent-written checks, not independent human gold
rules: Each scenario gets its own namespace and fresh fixture repositories (alpha, beta) whose files contain none of the facts below.
Sessions run in order, one CLI invocation each, with no shared conversation; only Mnemo can carry information between them.
Prompts never mention Mnemo or tools. Answer checks are case-insensitive regular expressions on the final reply; store checks count current memories whose 'subject predicate value' text matches.
A scenario passes only if every check passes.

scenarios.tests: a convention told to one agent is applied by the other in a later session

sessions.prompt: Heads-up for future work in this repo: every PR title must start with the ticket key in the form WID-<number>, followed by a colon, like 'WID-142: Fix login redirect'.
I'm opening a PR that fixes the login timeout; the ticket number is 318. What should the PR title be? Reply with only the title.

scenarios.tests: a note left by one agent at the end of its work reaches the next agent

sessions.prompt: I'm stopping for today. Note for whoever picks this up next: test_sync_timeout is flaky because of an upstream bug, so run the suite with `pytest -k 'not sync_timeout'` until the vendor ships a fix.
What exact command should I use to run this repo's test suite right now? Reply with only the command.

scenarios.tests: a changed fact replaces the old one instead of leaving it current

sessions.prompt: FYI, we deploy this service to production every Tuesday.
Heads-up: starting this week, production deploys for this service move from Tuesday to Thursday.
Which weekday do we deploy this service to production? Reply with one word.

scenarios.tests: a second value for the same kind of fact is added, not substituted

sessions.prompt: For reference, our local services: the API listens on port 8081 and the background worker on port 8090.
Also note: the admin UI runs locally on port 8095.
List every local port our services use, as comma-separated numbers only.

scenarios.tests: a project's memory stays out of another project and remains available in its own

sessions.prompt: Remember: this repo's staging database is named widget_stage_07.
What's the name of this repo's staging database? If you don't know, reply UNKNOWN.
What's the name of this repo's staging database? If you don't know, reply UNKNOWN.

scenarios.tests: a preference stated for all projects applies in a different project

sessions.prompt: A rule for all of my projects, not just this one: always manage Python packages with uv, never pip.
What single command would you run to add the requests package to this project? Reply with only the command.

scenarios.tests: restating a known fact does not create a second memory

sessions.prompt: Note: our Python code style is black with a line length of 100.
Reminder about our formatting rule: black, max line length 100.
What line length do we format Python code to? Reply with the number only.

checks.note: exactly one memory holds the rule

scenarios.tests: a memory the user retracts stops being current

sessions.prompt: Please remember: the on-call handoff for this team happens on Fridays.
Correction: I was wrong earlier, there is no on-call handoff day at all. Please remove that memory.
Is there a fixed on-call handoff day for this team? Reply with the day, or NONE.

scenarios.tests: small talk and a generic question are not stored

sessions.prompt: Ugh, long day, I'm tired and grabbing a coffee first. Quick question while I wait: what does `git status -sb` show? One sentence.

scenarios.tests: with nothing stored, the agent does not claim a memory

sessions.prompt: Who is the release manager for this repo? If you don't know, reply UNKNOWN.
